name: uv
description: Redirects pip to uv as a hook. Refuses a Bash command that runs pip install or pip uninstall, whether spelled pip, pip3, python -m pip or python3 -m pip, with or without sudo, anywhere in a compound command. Read-only pip subcommands, uv pip, pipx, pipenv and pip mentioned inside quotes or a heredoc all pass. The refusal names uv add or uv remove inside a uv project and uv pip outside one. Requires jq.
